text:
Nia: Quick heads-up: soft-launching Dedicated G730 micro-pools in Warsaw (WAW) and Johannesburg (JNB) today. Short reservation window + new soft-preempt policy. Docs/links below. :rocket:
ops-bot: [deploy] created pool g730-waw (size=10) and pool g730-jnb (size=6) 1 rollout=rl-2026-g730-01
Luca: Nice. Are these locked into reserved capacity or burst-only?
Nia: Phase 0 = limited reserved slots (by invite) + open burst reservations. Reservation window = up to 7 days for now. Intend to fold into reserved catalog in next quarter if stable.
billing: Pricing note: micro-pool surcharge = +8% per GPU-hour vs standard Dedicated. Enterprise customers with committed capacity can apply for surcharge waiver via billing case.
Luca: What about preemption? Can jobs be evicted?
Nia: Soft-preempt rule applies: micro-pool reservations are reclaimable when higher-priority reserved capacity needs them. Customers see 30m eviction notice webhook and auto-fallback routing to nearest compatible pool.
infra-team: Tagging policy: please set tags: region, project, env (e.g., `region=waw project=chatbot env=prod`). Un-tagged holds will be auto-cancelled after 12h.
eng-oncall: Ops note 1 alert policy created: metric pool.g730-*-utilization >= 85% for 10m -> page #eng-oncall and escalate to #infra if error_rate > 5%.
ops-bot: [rollout] canary 3/10 successful for g730-waw; canary 2/6 successful for g730-jnb. Rolling further at 10m intervals.
Luca: Any SLA differences?
Nia: Uptime SLA unchanged for Dedicated. Micro-pools are marked as "beta-limited-capacity" in the portal; we still honor uptime SLAs, but availability expectations are lower during phase 0. Mentioned in customer-facing doc.
Luca: Can we get a short migration snippet for eng teams?
Nia: CLI snippet below - copy/paste: 
```
# show micro-pools
redwoodctl pools list --filter "g730" --region waw
# reserve 1 GPU for 24h
redwoodctl reservations create --pool g730-waw --count 1 --duration 24h --tags project=my-app,env=staging
# cancel hold
redwoodctl reservations cancel --id <reservation-id>
```
billing: Reminder to sales: please disclose surcharge and soft-preempt policy when selling these pools. Use pricing code G730-MICRO in quotes.
infra-team: Operational safety: we9re enabling a 30m read-only mode for pool config during peak rollout windows to avoid accidental reconfigs.
eng-oncall: If latency regression > 20% for 3 intervals, routing auto-fallback triggers to nearest L-class pool; if errors persist, page infra and open incident.
Nia: Customer docs: https://redwood.ai/docs/dedicated/g730-micropools (reservation flow, preempt policy, pricing, SLA notes). Dashboard link will be appended in 2 hours.
Luca: Will this be available for reserved capacity purchases later?
Nia: Yes, roadmap: convert to standard reserved pool in 2026-Q3 if utilization and telemetry look good.
ops-bot: [note] housekeeping job scheduled: nightly cleanup removes stale temporary holds older than 12h for micro-pools.
Nia: Thanks all 1 please escalate any immediate issues to #eng-oncall. :pray:
